intent: Canonical-only prerelease: environment_manager is the sole domain with no legacy-domain migration code. Add room-owned per-profile temperature/humidity targets and make Automatic/PID/Manual method selection actively authorize the exact native controller to start/stop supported physical equipment under demand and safety gates.
note: Clean environment_manager-only install plus room profile targets and active controller method behavior
changes: Remove legacy-domain migration completely: no migration module, migration config-flow step, old-domain runtime constants, legacy storage import, or migration UI strings
Use only canonical environment_manager storage keys and flat HACS tag packaging
Expose Room Environment targets for Comfort, Home, Away, Sleep and Eco; show applicable heating, cooling and humidity targets based on selected equipment capabilities
Make Away use its explicit room profile targets rather than silently substituting room min/max temperature limits
Selecting Automatic, PID or Manual explicitly authorizes the exact supported native controller to regulate targets/speed and start/stop the physical device or native HVAC mode when demand requires it
Reselecting an active control method re-arms a prior software pause while preserving all physical safety gates
Use the physical entity's observed OFF age for minimum-OFF dwell, avoiding an artificial new delay just because the user selected PID/Automatic
Keep minimum ON/OFF, max runtime, availability, windows, physical ownership, defrost/interlock and command acknowledgement protections
